LanguageData.pas_wte_SettingEnableSiegeTip: When a Rim War warband is attacking one of your Empire vassal settlements, that settlement's resource production is multiplied down until the siege lifts.
LanguageData.pas_wte_SettingSiegeMultTip: The fraction of normal resource output a besieged settlement still produces. 0% = total shutdown, 100% = no penalty.
LanguageData.pas_wte_SettingEnableTaxTip: While your empire's faction is at war in Rim War (it has war factions), every vassal's tax silver is increased by the surcharge below to fund the war effort.
LanguageData.pas_wte_SettingTaxSurchargeTip: Extra tax silver collected from each settlement while at war, as a percentage of the normal amount. +25% means a settlement that would pay 100 silver pays 125.
